# Mercerline
> Track insider, politician, and fund filings on US equities as they clear.

Mercerline is a focused disclosure workspace for US equities. The product surfaces filings as they clear, then lets you open investor dossiers and company context when a disclosure matters.

## Site
- Home: https://mercerline.com/
- Sign in: https://mercerline.com/sign-in
- Contact: research@mercerline.com

## Product
- Daily disclosure recap
- Investor dossiers for insiders, politicians, and funds
- Company context on demand
- Macro calendar coverage for US, EU, UK, and China

## Coverage
- Form 4
- House PTR
- Senate PTR
- Executive PTR
- 13F
- SEC EDGAR
- Earnings transcripts
- Press
- 8-K
- Macro US / EU / UK / CN

## Notes
- Not investment advice.
- Public marketing pages are indexable. Signed-in terminal content requires authentication.
